homemaker = a person whose main work is running the home rather than paid employment
stay-at-home parent = a mother or father who looks after children instead of going out to work
family feud = a long, bitter quarrel between relatives
take after = to resemble an older relative in looks or character
look up to = to admire and respect someone
keep in touch = to continue communicating with someone
get on with = to have a friendly relationship with someone
fall out with = to stop being friendly after an argument
make up with = to become friends again after a quarrel
break up = to end a romantic relationship
split up = to end a relationship or marriage; to start living apart
go out with = to have a romantic relationship with someone
ask out = to invite someone to go on a date
on the rocks = in serious difficulty, especially a relationship
tie the knot = to get married
walk down the aisle = to go to the front of a church or venue to get married
best man = a male friend who supports the groom at a wedding
maid of honour = a female friend who supports the bride at a wedding
engagement = an agreement to get married; the period before the wedding
cohabit = to live together as a couple without being married
